downloads.colour: Seen from behind, a person sits at a plain white desk, back to the viewer; we see only the back of their head, shoulders and a green jumper. In front of them an open laptop whose screen shows a grid of small file icons. On the desk to the right: two identical photographs side by side under a round magnifying glass; a manila folder with a bright red tag clipped to it; a small metal waste bin holding crumpled papers you could still pull out; a mechanical tally counter. Beyond the desk, a tall bookshelf with neat labelled-looking boxes that carry no lettering.
downloads.keep: the person at the desk, the desk, the laptop and the bookshelf
downloads.erase: the two photographs and the magnifying glass, the manila folder with its red tag, the waste bin and the tally counter

book.colour: Seen from behind, a person stands at a large drawing table, back to the viewer; we see only the back of their head, shoulders and a rust-coloured cardigan. On the table: an open book lying flat as a two-page spread with grey bars of text and generous margins; a steel ruler laid across the spread; a round loupe resting on a column of text; a long printed proof sheet curling out of a desktop printer at the side; a printer's specification sheet with abstract diagrams pinned to the wall.
book.keep: the person, the drawing table and the open book
book.erase: the steel ruler, the loupe, the printer with its printed proof sheet and the sheet pinned to the wall

vercel.colour: Seen from behind, a person sits at a white desk with two monitors, back to the viewer; we see only the back of their head, shoulders and a grey hoodie. On the left monitor and the right monitor: two simple website wireframes in matching layouts, side by side. On the desk: a row of small cardboard crates on a shelf above the monitors; an open red toolbox with a plug adapter lying on top; a three-lamp signal light on the desk with green, red and amber lamps. Through a window behind the monitors: soft clouds.
vercel.keep: the person, the desk, the window with clouds and one monitor on the left
vercel.erase: the right monitor, the row of cardboard crates, the red toolbox with its plug adapter and the three-lamp signal light

honey.colour: Seen from behind, a person stands at a kitchen table by a window, back to the viewer; we see only the back of their head, shoulders and a mustard jumper, holding up a phone to photograph a glass jar of pale golden honey on the table. On the table: a laboratory certificate with a small microscope image of pollen grains and no lettering; a second phone lying flat showing a grid of square photos; a small round magnifier over the jar's blank label. Through the window: a field of blue borage flowers with beehives.
honey.keep: the person, the kitchen table, the honey jar and the window
honey.erase: the laboratory certificate, the second phone with its grid of photos, the magnifier, the borage field and the beehives outside (leave a plain green field)

blind.colour: Seen from behind, a judge in a dark jacket sits at a long white table, back to the viewer; we see only the back of their head and shoulders. On the table in front of them: five pairs of identical cream folders laid out in a row, each pair with plain cardboard covers hiding their labels; a score sheet with rows of small coloured bars and no lettering; a sealed envelope with a red wax seal set to one side. A single desk lamp lights the table.
blind.keep: the judge, the long table and the desk lamp
blind.erase: the five pairs of folders, the score sheet and the sealed envelope

car.colour: Seen from behind, a person sits at a plain white desk, back to the viewer; we see only the back of their head, shoulders and a blue jumper. On the desk in front of them: an open laptop whose screen shows a grid of small car thumbnails, two cream envelopes sealed with red wax, a folded road map with a route marked in red, and a set of car keys. Beyond the desk, through a large window, a small generic blue hatchback without badges is parked on a quiet street, lifted on a jack, and a mechanic in navy overalls stands with his back to the viewer beside it, shining an inspection lamp at the wheel arch.
car.keep: the person at the desk, the desk, the window frame and the blue car outside
car.erase: the mechanic and his lamp, the jack, the laptop, both envelopes, the road map and the car keys
